ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels in central regions and 35% low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels concentrated on the periphery.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and medial lobes are occupied by large, contiguous high-intensity regions. Low-intensity pixels form thick contiguous bands along the trailing edges and distal tips, with a mottled transition zone of fine-grained dark spots along the interior boundaries of the light fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 125 degrees; the central vertex is partially obscured by water-level pixel noise.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across both lobes. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits a significantly higher amplitude deviation (deep notch) compared to the more uniform micro-serrations on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge trajectory with distal tips exhibiting an upward, falcate sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized low-intensity pixel clusters (dark spots) visible on the medial-lower region of the left lobe and scattered along the lower margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct near-vertical, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) located in the mid-section of the left lobe's high-intensity region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, deep U-shaped indentation/tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately mid-way between the notch and the tip.
